hypothesis: The parent's only trace-visible budget leak is its re-ask loop: each re-ask shows only the latest rejected reply, so the 7B alternates between two zero-information picks (A(1,1,1) <-> B(1,1,1) in i107/i129) until MAX_TRIES runs out, and then the harness spends a query on the rejected pick. If each re-ask names every pick rejected that turn and gives a few usable queries in the exact tag format, and the harness never sends a pick its own tracker knows splits nothing, then zero-information queries per episode drop to 0 and re-ask call counts fall. Query choice, candidate pinning, and the final answer stay as in the parent.
